purpose: Global citizen↔state structural-asymmetry instruments (laws/institutions/doctrines/values) with enactor (誰が) / origin (経緯) / stakeholders (関係者), read off via system dynamics. Analysis-only (G4); hypotheses only (G5); aggregate-only (G6).
regenerate: bb --classpath 20-actors -e "(require '[junkan.methods.junkan-edn :as je] '[junkan.methods.analyze :as az] '[junkan.methods.kotoba :as k]) (let [is (je/instruments \"20-actors/junkan/kotoba/seed.governance-asymmetry.edn\") a (az/analyze is) ds (az/datoms is a) tx (k/make-tx ds \"junkan-gov-snapshot-0001\" \"snapshot\" \"\")] (spit \"80-data/junkan-governance/governance-asymmetry.datoms.kotoba.edn\" (az/render-datoms is a)) (spit \"80-data/junkan-governance/findings-ledger.kotoba.edn\" (k/tx->edn tx)) (spit \"80-data/junkan-governance/report.md\" (az/render-report a)))"
tx_cid_note: tx-cid reproducible byte-for-byte from the seed (deterministic content-address); changes only when the seed changes.
sourcing: representative (laws/years/enactors/origins are on-the-record public facts; polarity/magnitude/confidence are junkan's disclosed hypotheses, G5)
discipline: G4 analysis-only / G5 hypothesis-only / G6 aggregate-only / G7 map-not-rank / G11 candidates-not-directives
